context: Inventory at least four materially different producers plus serializer, loader, and comparison consumers. Define semantic fields and missing/null/zero behavior before implementation. Introduce compatibility constructors first, migrate boundaries in vertical slices, and use property-based round-trip tests. Unknown and conflicting fields require an explicit forward-compatibility/diagnostic policy. Do not flag-day rewrite adapters.
description: The zero-row export and duration-unit comparison defects are instances of a broader parallel-representation problem: adapters, enhanced results, compact JSON, loaders, comparison code, and compatibility dictionaries independently interpret row counts, durations, status, digest, errors, and plan capture. Define one typed internal QueryExecution contract and explicit compatibility adapters so normalization occurs once at each boundary. Preserve the canonical v2 external artifact unless a separately reviewed version migration is proven necessary.
